name: Bali, Indonesia
description: Find your rhythm among emerald rice terraces, hidden waterfalls, temple sunsets, and beachside cafés. Bali is a beautiful balance of slow mornings and unforgettable adventures.

name: Manali, India
description: Breathe in crisp mountain air, wander pine-scented trails, and watch the Himalayas glow at golden hour. A refreshing getaway for nature lovers and mountain dreamers.

name: Jaipur, India
description: Step into a world of rose-coloured streets, intricate palaces, lively bazaars, and Rajasthani flavours. Jaipur brings centuries of craft and culture into every corner.

name: Meghalaya, India
description: Follow misty roads into living-root bridges, lush valleys, caves, and waterfalls. Meghalaya rewards curious travellers with a wild, green world that feels wonderfully different.

name: South Goa, India
description: Trade your schedule for sea breezes, quiet sandy coves, Portuguese-era lanes, and long sunset walks. South Goa is made for doing a little less and feeling a little more.

name: Swiss Alps, Switzerland
description: Ride scenic trains past storybook villages, alpine lakes, and snow-dusted peaks. The Swiss Alps are a dreamscape for travellers who love grand landscapes and little details.

name: Varanasi, India
description: Experience riverside mornings, ancient lanes, craft traditions, and the timeless atmosphere of one of India's oldest living cities. Come with curiosity and leave with stories.

name: Rishikesh, India
description: Pair riverside calm with a little adrenaline. From forest walks and yoga by the Ganges to seasonal rafting and cliffside views, Rishikesh offers room to reset and explore.
